content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹50,000 per month. The appointment is on a full-time contract basis for one year, likely to continue and renewable based on performance. The place of posting is at the University headquarters in Kollam, but candidates are liable to be served at any Regional Centre of the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGOU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online through the University recruitment portal at the official website. Fill in all particulars and upload legible copies of required documents. Remit the non-refundable application fee of ₹1000/- for General / OBC or ₹500/- for SC / ST / PwBD online to Account No. 361401010035599, IFSC: UBIN0536148, Branch: Union Bank, Kollam -1. Obtain a copy of the fee receipt to submit along with the hard copy of the application. Send a printout of the submitted application with self-attested copies of documents to: The Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kureepuzha, Kollam, Kerala. Ensure the envelope is superscribed "Application for the post of Assistant Professor in Teacher Education — [Curricular Area]". Candidates applying for more than one curricular area must submit separate applications with required fees.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificates and mark lists of all qualifications starting from SSLC onwards NET/SET/SLET certificate, or Ph.D. certificate with proof of compliance with UGC Regulations Experience certificates from the head of the institution Proof of date of birth Community / Non-Creamy Layer / disability certificate, wherever applicable Copies of the first page of research publications, with journal and ISSN details No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates in service

faq.question: Q1. Is the Assistant Professor post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a full-time contract basis for one year, likely to continue, and is renewable based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in marks or qualifications?
faq.answer: Relaxations in qualifications are applicable as per UGC norms and Kerala Government rules.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted and selected for the position?
faq.answer: Selection is made by a Selection Committee in three stages: scrutiny and shortlisting based on academic record, research score, and teaching experience; a teaching demonstration or seminar on a topic from the B.Ed. curriculum; and an interview assessing subject knowledge, teaching ability, research aptitude, understanding of ODL and NEP 2020, and communication skills.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a Ph.D. in Education or pedagogy (for NET/SET qualified candidates), research papers in UGC-CARE listed scopus or peer-reviewed journals, books, or chapters in edited volumes, proficiency in e-development and LMS, experience in supervising school internship, training in inclusive education, ability to teach and develop course material in Malayalam and English, and participation in Faculty Development Programmes or seminars.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents need to be sent with the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send certificates and mark lists from SSLC onwards, NET/SET/SLET or Ph.D. certificate, experience certificates, proof of date of birth, community/disability certificate if applicable, copies of the first page of research publications, fee receipt, and an NOC if in service.
